name: Password Strength Meter
description: A progressbar-style meter that visualizes password strength from a caller-supplied or built-in score.

anatomy.description: The meter label and the current strength band text, spaced apart on one row.
A progressbar with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 4, and the band name as aria-valuetext.
The colored portion reflecting the clamped 0–4 score; never the only signal, since the band is also text.

dos: Place it directly under the PasswordInput it scores and pass the live password value.
Supply a real estimator such as zxcvbn through the score prop for sign-up flows.
Keep the visible band text on; hide it only when space is truly constrained.
donts: Don't use the meter as the only statement of password requirements; list the rules too.
Don't block submission on the meter alone; enforce policy server-side.

examples.title: Default heuristic
examples.description: The built-in scorer rewards length and character variety, mapping passwords onto five labeled bands.

examples.title: Custom scorer
examples.description: Bring your own scoring function (for example zxcvbn) or hide the visible text while keeping the accessible value.

guidance.useWhen: A sign-up or password-change flow should give live feedback on password quality next to a PasswordInput.
guidance.avoidWhen: You only need to state requirements; a description list under PasswordInput is simpler and less noisy.
guidance.behavior: Scores are clamped to 0–4 and mapped to Very weak through Very strong; the score prop replaces the default heuristic entirely.
guidance.responsive: The meter stretches to fill its container; the label and strength text stay on one row with space between.

notes: Exposes role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 4, and the band name as aria-valuetext.
The strength is never conveyed by color alone; the band label is visible text and an accessible value.

props.description: Custom scoring function returning 0 (very weak) to 4 (very strong).
props.name: score

props.description: Hides the visible strength text; assistive technology still hears it via aria-valuetext.
props.name: showLabel
